scripts.build: npm run -w @oiu/shared build && npm run -w @oiu/extension build && npm run -w @oiu/server build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @oiu/shared typecheck && npm run -w @oiu/extension typecheck && npm run -w @oiu/server typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w @oiu/shared test && npm run -w @oiu/server test
scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; Compress-Archive -Path packages/extension/dist/* -DestinationPath oiu-extension.zip -Force"
